tool.name: TaxonKit Database Downloader
tool.description: Download and populate the NCBI Taxonomy database for TaxonKit

param.name: db_name
param.label: Database display name
param.help: This name will be displayed to users in the database selection dropdown (e.g., NCBI Taxonomy 2026-06).

tool.help:
===================================================== TaxonKit Data Manager =====================================================
This tool uses the Galaxy Data Manager framework to download the latest NCBI Taxonomy database (``taxdump.tar.gz``) from the official NCBI FTP server, extracts the files required for TaxonKit, and registers them into the shared data tables.
Once completed, the database will be registered under the ``taxonkit_format`` data table. General users can then select this database from a dropdown menu when running the TaxonKit tool wrapper.
